principles: A dependency is any external code, binary, model, corpus, standard dataset, tool, service, or response whose identity or behavior can affect a Laplace calculation.
The latest supported upstream release is selected by default; an older selection requires a documented incompatibility, regression, license, platform, determinism, or acceptance finding.
A dependency supplies a declared calculation, storage, transport, testimony, tooling, test, or acceleration capability and never becomes semantic authority.
Logical behavior remains identical across execution providers unless the operation contract explicitly declares a numeric tolerance or hardware-specific result class.
Source selection, build flags, ABI closure, runtime object identity, threading, and deterministic numeric controls are receipt inputs.
A package profile contains one compatible dependency graph and cannot rely on ambient feature libraries from the host.
